project_name: Sampark (SIH26129) - Maharashtra Smart Government Integration Portal

persona_and_theme.target_audience: Citizens of Maharashtra (primary), Department Officers, and Operations Officers
persona_and_theme.tone: Trustworthy, authoritative, highly legible, clean, and accessible state government digital portal
persona_and_theme.theme_mode: Light theme primary with deep navy header and saffron state accent line

fonts.rationale: Plus Jakarta Sans provides high x-height and exceptional readability for government digital interfaces. Noto Sans Devanagari ensures crisp Marathi rendering for brand caption (संपर्क · महाराष्ट्र). JetBrains Mono ensures legible transaction IDs and technical codes.

spacing_scale.row_height: min-height 52px for table rows, min-height 64px for application list items

citizen_portal_declutter.rule: Show maximum 3-4 cards or items at a glance with clear primary CTA. Collapsible details for past applications.
first_time_citizen_view: Header with Maharashtra State Emblem + User role switch
Primary action hero band ('Apply for New Scheme')
3 Scheme Catalogue Cards (Skill Development, Social Justice, Agriculture)
My Active Applications table (Max 3 visible by default with 'View All' expander)

operator_overview_declutter.fabric_diagram: Collapsible or structured 3-connector grid with 20px padding
operator_overview_declutter.recent_journeys: Limit initial table display to 5 most recent transactions with pagination

microcopy_tone_guidelines.operator_facing: Keep precise technical metadata (e.g. TXN IDs, lineage trace, payload diffs, connector status).

testing_attributes.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, role pickers, application forms, scheme cards, filter dropdowns, and sanction buttons MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the Google Fonts import into App.css or index.html.
Apply the REMAP TABLE to App.css to systematically eliminate 7px-11px text and set body base font-size to 16px.
Update --font-body to 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif and brand caption font to 'Noto Sans Devanagari'.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px on mobile viewports.
Maintain the established Maharashtra Navy (#0a2540) and Saffron accent visual identity while decluttering density.
